{{Top|leg}}
[[Galactic Solutions Industries]] maintained an '''Biodesign Division''' that researched and produced gear based on the natural abilities of existing creatures. One of their projects was the retrieval of [[makrin creeper]] [[protobark]] so that they could create damage-resistant wilderness gear.
